description: Defines a template class 'NoDestructor' that provides a way to create objects with static storage duration that are only constructed on first access and never invoke their destructor, primarily to avoid static initialization order issues and destructor calls. Includes usage examples and considerations about memory leaks.

classes.name: NoDestructor
classes.description: A template class that manages object lifetime by constructing an object of type T in-place with static storage, avoiding destructor invocation.

methods.name: NoDestructor
methods.description: Constructor template that constructs an object of type T with forwarded arguments.

methods.name: NoDestructor(const T &x)
methods.description: Constructs the object by copying from x.

methods.name: NoDestructor(T &&x)
methods.description: Constructs the object by moving from x.

methods.name: operator*()
methods.description: Dereference operator returning a reference to the stored object.

methods.name: operator->()
methods.description: Arrow operator returning a pointer to the stored object.

methods.name: get()
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the stored object.
